overview:
**Fire danger is High today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, driven by low humidity (23% min RH) and elevated fuel dryness (ERC 82%, BI 72%).**
- Danger stays High through Sept 12, with ERC climbing to 86–88% and BI to 81% by midweek as fuels continue drying.
- Weather stays warm and dry with light ENE–NNE winds (7–11 mph); minimal rain is expected until a light shower Sept 12.
- One of seven local watchout thresholds is met today (minimum relative humidity); no Red Flag Warning is currently posted for this area.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands covering Montrose, San Miguel, Ouray, Delta, and part of Gunnison counties, while the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests have removed all fire restrictions effective September 3, 2026.
- The Elk Fire northwest of Lake City (Hinsdale/Gunnison counties) is holding at 7,257 acres and 73% contained with minimal fire behavior.
